_meta.presentation: Questions and labeled options are in German; concise metalinguistic why feedback is in English. Options are statically ordered for think-then-reveal self-grading.
_meta.validation_notes: Every decision contrasts two human or institutional participants for whom either direction is contextually plausible. Overt masculine determiner, adjective, relative-pronoun, and where applicable weak-noun morphology uniquely assigns the roles. Surface order and lexical stems stay fixed in each full-sentence contrast_form; only role-bearing case morphology changes, and the contrast flips to the sole unselected option. No reversed contrast is duplicated as a seed row. Content order and correct labels are stored in a frozen, deterministic constrained permutation; labels are cross-balanced by routing case and construction, have no short repeated cycle, and never run more than three times consecutively.
